title: Sequence
description: A sequence: a generator function of a SequenceContext. It is a reusable definition, called anew for every Sequencer.play and every branch that runs it. ```ts const blink = function* (context: SequenceContext): SequenceGenerator { for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { sprite.visible = !sprite.visible; yield* context.wait(0.2); } }; ``` Nest a sequence inside another step's own flow with `yield* blink(context)`, or run it as a branch of its own with SequenceContext.start, SequenceContext.all or SequenceContext.race.
